summary: Spec fidelity (brief questions: 'the implementer decides which glob syntax to use and records it'; CHANGELOG 1.2.0 of the crate says 'atip check --help names every key'): the glob syntax of allowedEffects (* any run but /, ** any run, ? one character but /, no classes or braces, ./ optional, ~/ for HOME, whole-path match) is written only in the doc comment of crates/atip-check/src/l2/glob.rs, which also says 'the report of a change names it'. The report message ('a successful read changed X (outside its allowedEffects)'), the CHANGELOG ('allowedEffects (glob list)') and `atip check --help` (cli.rs:64 lists batchFailsAt and batchFailsFirst but not preview, async, allowedEffects or the top-level search) do not. A fixture author cannot learn the syntax or the ~/ prefix without reading source. Blast radius: every fixture that uses the L2 keys.
